translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

content: Yisu gimdil vukuri
Amolmol ili Sonda gikwai bekob Malia Magdala gabu Jems tine Malia be Salomi, sotol imdil tistumi ge be ivwat marasin ukwas subu, ebe ivgo ok, be ile ve inro nireu Yisu utle ulis.
Givin Sonda tistumi ge sotol imdil be ve invang taku gimat ane.
Be gaptol inei ve isate nangge luev be inei; “Atob ret nemb eitit ru be nindugdug vat taptape bamo etok nikwai nalk avo ebe Yisu giengk ok.”
(Sotol iutani isate dang etok, ve vat etok bamo molge be sotol gitangi ebe atob indugdug nikwai ok ite). Bekob nas gile be ili vat bamo nok ebe ande gidugdug gikwai nalk avo ebe Yisu giengk ok.
Be gaptol iwav isov nalk avo ile be ili amol ti gino kup bogbogo ge be gibweg, love ikuri vunu-ngge be ipelk.

Be amol nok ginei gitangi sotol be ginei; “Unpelk bwaya! Ve Ayeu ande gatpweng yemtol are gikwai. Yemtol urek Yisu Nasaret ane, ebe warik amolmol valir ane es ei gireu ei ok. Bemem ei giengk etenik ite ma. Ei ande gimdil gikwai. Taundi e. Lavo ebe Josep gitak ei giengk ok ande bun.
Be unde be unei nitangi Pita be tis eisir singamolomb tavlu be unei; Yisu atob nimungg nile Galilaia ok bekob yem. Be atob yem undi ei nangge eteok dang ebe warik ginei gitangi aim ok.”
Beti sotol ile ihlang ikwai nalk avo be ituvki ile ihlang ikwai taku gimat ane seukie-ngge, ve sotol ikurkuri be ipelk tiate molge. Be inei yaun ti gitangi amolmol ite ve ipelk.
Malia Magdala gili Yisu
Yisu gimdil tis Sonda tis tumi ge gikwai kob ete Malia Magdala ebe warik Yisu gitin ngalau tiate 7 gikwai ei ok gili ei ulu.

Bekob gile be gili eisir singamolomb ebe aplos bunam ve Yisu ane be ilgum tangir imbweg ok, be ginei gitangi eisir be ginei; “Yisu ande matawe be gimdil vukuri. Be Ande ayeu gali ei gikwai.” Bemem eisir singamolomb aplos givin Malia ane yaun ite.
Yisu gile gihlang ve ane singamolomb ailu nangge luev
As mate ailu gile gikwai kob eisir singamolomb as amol ailu imdil be ivang ve ile. Bekob Yisu geb na gile amol ebeok ti be gile gihlang ve sulu nangge luev.
Bekob ete gabu ile be iput yaun etok gitangi eisir singamolomb tavlu, bemem eisir aplos givin sulu as yaun ite weik etok ge.
Yisu gile gihlang ve ane singamolomb-gen 11
Bwayage kob givin ebe eisir singamolomb 11 etok en ben imbweg nam aplo ok, okob Yisu ei ate gibielk ve eisir. Be gigo is gisov ebe iute amol be avie ebe ili ei gimdil vukuri ano ok as yaun ite ok.
Bekob ginei gitangi eisir be ginei; “Yem unvang untangi taku walang ok unde, be unbul amolmol tepwengge ve awangg yaun.

Amol ti ginei aplo givin ayeu ano ge be giringk bui sanggu atob amol etok nimbweg matawe nindeb mulane. Be ginei amol ti aplo givin ayeu ite be giringk bui sanggu ite, atob amol etok ninggas yaun bamo molge be nireu yev bamo ebe giengk dang etok painge-ngge ok nile.

Amolmol ebe aplos givin ayeu ok eisir gitangi inalgum gen gwangne ti weik inaitin ngalau tiate nikwai amolmol ve ayeu arengg ane. Be eisir gitangi ebe atob inei yaun niengk amolmol walang ok as yaun ok.

Be ginei eisir emb mwat me inum marasin ebe gitangi ve nes amolmol vunu ok, bemem gen etok gitangi ebe atob niaing eisir ok ite ma. Be eisir gitangi ebe atob ines miengk nitangi Pomate be intak bais niwei amolmol ebe tis gimat ok be utlas vie vukuri ok.
Yisu gireu gulumb gile
Amol Bamo Yisu kakie givin ane singamolomb-gen gikwai kob ete Pomate gigas ei gireu gulumb gile gibweg gibloblo Pomate be gigas Pomate ane gwangne.

Be eisir singamolomb ivang emb taku walang ok avut be imbul amolmol ve Yisu ane yaun. Be Pomate geb kulkul givin eisir be geb ane gwangne gitangi eisir be inei Yisu ane yaun gitangi amolmol. Be amolmol ili gen bwalbwale bambamo ebe Yisu ane singamolomb-gen ilgum ok beti itpweng yaun etok are inei yaun ano molge.
